# How to Acknowledge an Email Professionally

Here are some templates and tips for acknowledging emails:

## Simple Acknowledgments

**Quick confirmation:**
> "Hi [Name], thank you for your email. I've received it and will review it shortly."

**With timeframe:**
> "Hi [Name], thanks for reaching out. I've received your message and will get back to you by [date/time]."

## For Specific Situations

**Received documents/files:**
> "Hi [Name], confirming I've received the [document/file]. I'll review it and follow up with any questions."

**Request or task assigned:**
> "Hi [Name], thank you for the details. I'll work on this and have it completed by [date]."

**Information received:**
> "Hi [Name], thank you for the update. Noted and understood."

**Meeting confirmation:**
> "Hi [Name], confirming our meeting on [date] at [time]. Looking forward to it."

## Key Elements to Include

1. **Greeting** – Address the sender by name
2. **Thank them** – Acknowledge their effort in reaching out
3. **Confirm receipt** – Clearly state you've received it
4. **Next steps** – Mention what you'll do or when they'll hear back
5. **Sign-off** – Professional closing (Best regards, Thanks, etc.)

## Sample Full Email

> Subject: Re: [Original Subject]
>
> Hi [Name],
>
> Thank you for your email. I've received the information and will review it carefully. I'll get back to you by [day/date] with my response.
>
> Please let me know if anything urgent comes up in the meantime.
>
> Best regards,
> [Your Name]
